title: Bug 598820: Item Availability by Event from Prod. Order ignores demand after Due Date
summary: Production Order availability by event now shows demand and supply after the due date by clearing the date filter before calculating availability.
key_points: Removed the upper date bound from the Item Date Filter when displaying Item Availability by Event from a production order
Ensures production order event view matches the behavior of Item Card and by-period views
Added test case verifying that sales orders dated after the production order due date appear in the availability calculation
